failure_interpretation: OOM or cap failure with zero/partial gradients remains partial infrastructure evidence, never a gradient-interference conclusion.
peak_scope: torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats occurs after model load; workload peaks therefore exclude persistent model-load allocation. The after-model-load current allocation and reservation are separately recorded.
purpose: Prospective CUDA memory evidence for a distinct physical-B8 lower-memory execution; not a feasibility claim.
